title: The range: DoD testing playground in the California desert
summary: Jake Barber tells of The range: DoD testing playground in the California desert, about after 2001 at California desert, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh the range was a giant playground for Department of Defense and its private aerospace partners for testing weapons technology,

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he once helped retrieve a UFO, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about where he worked after 2001. He describes "the range" in the California desert as a giant playground where the US Department of Defense and its private aerospace partners tested weapons technology. It is the setting he gives for the secret work he describes.
